_meta.openai/annotationJustification: Replaces the site's third-party analytics script on every live page, effective immediately.

description: Connect a third-party analytics provider (GA4, Plausible, Fathom, Umami) or remove it (provider 'none'). Dotsy adds the provider's script to the <head> of every live page — live immediately, no publish needed. Replaces any earlier provider (one per site). Use this instead of pasting a GA4 gtag snippet into a layout. Other tags (Google Tag Manager, ads pixels, Clarity, search-console verification <meta>) still go in the layout.

context.description: One sentence: why you are calling this tool and what you are trying to accomplish. Stored on the site's activity log and visible to everyone on the site — never put secrets or personal data here.

domain.description: Plausible only: the site domain registered in Plausible, e.g. example.com.

guestToken.description: Guest token from start_site. Send it on every call until claim_site. Omit when this chat is already signed in to Dotsy.

host.description: Umami only: https origin of the Umami instance, e.g. https://umami.example.com.

measurementId.description: GA4 only: measurement ID, e.g. G-ABC123XYZ.

name: set_analytics_provider
